svg.title: EntraGuard — source-verified solution architecture
svg.desc: Two verification entry paths reach a single-replica Media Service in Azure Container Apps. Azure Communication Services carries calls and media, Azure AI Speech transcribes audio, Azure OpenAI scores conversation risk, and Microsoft Graph supplies contextual facts. Deterministic verification code controls outcomes. Supporting services are Azure Table Storage, an internal voiceprint Container App, Key Vault for EAM signing, and Log Analytics with Sentinel. The operator console receives SignalR events. This logical verification view is checked against repository source, not a live deployment audit.
svg.text: Contextual identity verification + conversation risk analysis
Also reads Graph / KQL / Resource Graph
AZURE CONTAINER APPS · MEDIA SERVICE · ONE REPLICA
EAM hint validation OR Treasury owner/session
Coordinator + adjudicator; AI cannot grant access
EAM → signed result / refusal to Entra
Treasury → durable receipt → policy / grant checks
Calls Teams / ACS browser or handset web
Linked AI services: scripted speech / prompts
Stateless scoring; internal Container App ingress
Observe mode by default · no access authority
Remote RS256 signing for configured EAM
Private signing key stays in the vault
Log Analytics + Microsoft Sentinel · DCE / DCR
Logical verification view · 5 Container Apps / 3 images, including the public handbook · Azure access primarily uses managed identity.
Verification flow; monitored-call remediation is a separate branch. Source/config review, not a live audit. Official Microsoft icons · see asset credits.
